messages.content: You read a support policy and say what it determines. JSON only.

## Policy (the call's system message)
You are HelpHub's order-support agent. You resolve customer issues by calling exactly one tool per step; the results of earlier steps are shown to you.

- lookup_order: use when you need order details (status, items, total, charges) that you do not have yet. Only use an order id that appears in the customer's message.
- issue_refund: use only after the order has been looked up and the customer is eligible: the item arrived damaged or missing, or the customer was charged twice. Refund no more than the amount paid, and never more than 200.00 in one step.
- escalate_to_human: use for legal threats, fraud or chargeback claims, refunds above 200.00, abusive messages, requests without any order id, and anything the other tools cannot resolve.

## Tools
[{"name": "lookup_order", "description": "Fetch an order's status, items, total and charges from the order system.", "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string", "description": "Order id, e.g. HH-48213"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}, {"name": "issue_refund", "description": "Refund part or all of an order to the original payment method.", "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string", "description": "Order id, e.g. HH-48213"}, "amount": {"type": "number", "description": "Refund amount, at most 200.00"}, "currency": {"type": "string", "description": "ISO 4217 code of the order"}, "reason": {"type": "string", "enum": ["damaged", "missing_item", "duplicate_charge", "other"]}}, "required": ["order_id", "amount", "currency", "reason"]}}, {"name": "escalate_to_human", "description": "Hand the ticket to a human support agent.", "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"reason": {"type": "string", "description": "One sentence for the human agent"}, "priority": {"type": "string", "enum": ["low", "normal", "urgent"]}}, "required": ["reason", "priority"]}}]

## Task
1. For each enum argument below, list the values the policy can lead to when that tool is called. Leave out
values the policy rules out for that tool (for example a reason the policy never accepts). Give an empty list
when the policy never says how the argument's value is chosen.
- issue_refund.reason: ["damaged", "missing_item", "duplicate_charge", "other"]
- escalate_to_human.priority: ["low", "normal", "urgent"]
2. For each tool, list the tools the policy requires to have been called in an earlier step (empty if none).
Reply {"enums": [{"tool", "arg", "values"}], "tools": [{"tool", "requires"}]}.
